input.method: speccheck/moe_ref.py §Input generation: fp32 torch.randn from a private torch.Generator('cpu').manual_seed(seed), each row rescaled to RMS exactly 1.0, cast to bf16. [ASSUMPTION A-01] RMS-1 models post_attention_layernorm output; it does NOT carry the (1+weight) modulation of a real activation

reading_rules.payload: raw little-endian element bytes, no header; bytes == elements x itemsize, and `verify` refuses a record whose size cannot hold its own declared shape (pitfalls/30 §Read a dump's dtype off its file size)
reading_rules.bf16: two bytes per element, bit image — read with a uint16 view then bitcast, never cast the uint16 to a float (pitfalls/30 §Tensor.to casts, .view bitcasts)
reading_rules.slot axis: expert_raw/routed_sum are indexed by top-k SLOT. The *_exact arm's slots follow the fp64 router's own rank order, which can permute a tie relative to the bf16 router; compare those along K sorted by topk_ids_exact (speccheck/cross_check_hf.py §canon_raw)
reading_rules.authoritative: topk_weights is the cast-BEFORE tensor (the reference's form, README prediction 4 verified in source); topk_weights_f32 is the pre-cast value, kept so the cast-after form can be measured
